files.content_text:
# hello-world

Sample app demonstrating the Acme service skeleton.

## Getting started

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python src/app.py
```

Flask==3.0.0
requests==2.31.0
pytest==8.0.0

name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.12' }
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

# ci-pipeline

Reusable CI lint/test/deploy pipeline hardening.

name: lint
on: [push]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install ruff
      - run: ruff check .

name: test
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: ${{ matrix.python }} }
      - run: pip install pytest
      - run: pytest

version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule: { interval: weekly }

# data-warehouse

Analytics warehouse models and Airflow DAGs.
select id, customer_id, total, status, order_date from source('raw', 'orders')

select date_trunc('day', order_date) as day,
       sum(total) as revenue,
       count(*) as orders
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
where status = 'delivered'
group by 1

from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from datetime import datetime

with DAG('daily_revenue', start_date=datetime(2025,1,1), schedule='@daily') as dag:
    run = BashOperator(task_id='run_dbt', bash_command='cd /dbt && dbt run -s fct_revenue')

name: data_warehouse
version: '1.0'
profile: warehouse
models:

issues.title: Typo in README header
issues.body: There is a typo in the README header: 'hello-wrld'.

issues.title: Add login feature
issues.body: We need a login flow with email + password and OAuth.

issues.title: Document local dev setup
issues.body: The README lacks a 'getting started' section.

issues.title: Health endpoint returns 500 under load
issues.body: /health returns 500 when the DB pool is exhausted.

issues.title: Bump Flask to 3.0
issues.body: Security advisory for Flask < 3.0.

issues.title: Lint job fails on main
issues.body: The lint workflow is red after the matrix PR merged.

issues.title: Add dependabot config
issues.body: Enable dependabot for github-actions.

issues.title: Cache pip wheels
issues.body: CI is slow; cache pip wheels between runs.

issues.title: Gateway 5xx not retried
issues.body: Transient gateway 5xx should be retried with backoff.

issues.title: Idempotency keys missing on refunds
issues.body: Refunds can be double-processed without idempotency keys.

issues.title: Multi-currency support
issues.body: Support EUR and GBP settlement.

issues.title: Ledger events missing tax field
issues.body: ledger.go events omit the tax_amount field.

issues.title: PCI-DSS quarterly review
issues.body: Quarterly PCI-DSS attestation due.

issues.title: Cart drawer not accessible
issues.body: Cart drawer lacks ARIA labels and keyboard focus trap.

issues.title: Hydration mismatch on product grid
issues.body: Server/client markup diverges for the price tag.

issues.title: Add product reviews
issues.body: Customers want to leave reviews.

issues.title: Checkout requires SSO redirect
issues.body: Checkout should redirect to IdP then return.

issues.title: Mobile cart total overflow
issues.body: On small screens the cart total wraps awkwardly.

issues.title: Daily revenue model off by timezone
issues.body: fct_revenue groups in UTC but finance wants PT.

issues.title: Backfill DAG missing retry policy
issues.body: daily_revenue.py has no retries.

issues.title: Add dbt tests for fct_revenue
issues.body: No not-null / unique tests on revenue model.

issues.title: Document warehouse refresh cadence
issues.body: Stakeholders don't know when dashboards refresh.

issue_comments.body: Let's scope OAuth to a follow-up.
Reproduced — pool size is 5, should be 20.
On it — will add focus trap.

pulls.title: Emit ledger events
pulls.body: Publishes ledger events on authorize/capture. Refs #4.

pulls.title: Accessible cart drawer
